comment: Sevii quest chain, beat 1: Celio's request (pokefirered OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_EventScript_CelioRequestRuby). Played when the player first talks to Celio with the source's precondition met - in FRLG that is the National Pokedex, which Oak grants after the Elite Four; the PUW mapping of that precondition is the campaign's champion stage, hence requires.min_stage. Lines are exact labels from the restored Sevii bank (production/sevii_dialogue), all carried by the bridge ref OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_EventScript_Celio, in the source script's own order: he can be useful, the far-away trading pitch, the special gemstone he needs. Sets sevii_celio_quest_started (authored flag chain for this quest; the source's VAR_MAP_SCENE value 4, 'waiting for Ruby').
